Name: Tappuah
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the lowland of Judah
Description: Tappuah was a town in Judah's lowland (Shephelah), named in the town list of Joshua 15. No further story is attached to it in Scripture, and its exact site is unidentified.
BiblicalSignificance: Its inclusion in the allotment list marks it as one of the towns assigned to Judah.
